First public release of **Tsuzuri 綴**, offline voice dictation for macOS. Licensed under **MIT** (the KanaWorks_AI brand assets, including the app icon, are not covered; see `docs/brand`).

## What's in it

- Menu bar app for Apple Silicon Macs (macOS 14+). Hold right ⌥ Option (or right ⌘ / Fn) to talk, or tap to start and stop; Esc cancels.
- Speech recognition with Qwen3-ASR (1.7B or 0.6B), running locally through MLX Swift: 30 languages and 22 Chinese dialects, detected automatically, tuned for English, Japanese and Chinese and for mixing them in one sentence. The menu lets you pin one of the 30 languages instead. Silero VAD trims silence.
- On first launch a setup window walks you through the Microphone and Accessibility permissions; until Accessibility is on, the menu bar icon shows a warning badge.
- Text is pasted into the focused app through the clipboard, which is restored afterwards. If no text field has focus, the text stays on the clipboard; the menu keeps your last 10 results in memory.
- Optional Polish with a local spokenly/cleanup-1 model: punctuation, filler-word removal, self-corrections and digits, with safety checks that fall back to the raw transcript. Only used for the languages the model was trained on (English, German, Spanish, French, Chinese, Russian, Japanese); other languages are pasted as recognized. Off by default, skipped in terminals.
- UI in 30 languages, following your macOS language: English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Macedonian, Malay, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish and Vietnamese.
- `tsuzuri-cli` for transcribing audio files from the command line.

Supported languages: Arabic, Cantonese, Chinese, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese. Chinese dialects: Anhui, Dongbei, Fujian, Gansu, Guizhou, Hebei, Henan, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Ningxia, Shandong, Shaanxi, Shanxi, Sichuan, Tianjin, Yunnan, Zhejiang, Cantonese (Hong Kong), Cantonese (Guangdong), Wu, Min Nan.

## Install

Download `Tsuzuri-0.1.0.dmg` below (signed and notarized), drag Tsuzuri into Applications, then download a speech model as described in the [README](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/tsuzuri#-install). Models are not bundled.
